recipes.notes: stb has no tags: pins are commit pairs, each the upstream 'update version numbers' commit (stb_image 2.23, 2.26, 2.27, 2.28) plus 013ac3b (2.30). The single-header libraries are compiled through five authored one-line translation-unit wrappers (the *_IMPLEMENTATION define then the header) and stb_vorbis.c, which is an ordinary C file; changed-function files are therefore the headers. LICENSE exists only from 2020-02-02, so the 2019 stb_vorbis CVE cards stay no-recipe. Each pin passes native gcc -fsyntax-only on all six units and links as a shared object; built with mingw-w64 gcc 13-win32 -O2 -g at every card pin. MIT is chosen from the dual MIT / Unlicense LICENSE (alternative A).
